units.source_text: 左右两方所出品的画，全都精妙无比，一时难于判定优劣。

en.t: The paintings presented by both the left and right sides were all exquisitely fine, and for the moment it was hard to judge which were superior.

units.source_text: 朱雀院送给梅壶女御的那些四季景色画，都由古代大画家精选优美题材，笔致流畅，全无滞涩，

en.t: The paintings of the four seasons that Emperor Suzaku had given to the Lady of the Plum Pavilion had all been made by great painters of old, who had chosen beautiful subjects with care, and their brushwork flowed smoothly without the slightest stiffness,
so their beauty was beyond compare.

units.source_text: 只是由于这是单张的纸画，画纸幅面有限，不能尽情写出山水绵延浩瀚之趣。

en.t: Yet because they were single-sheet paper paintings, the space was limited, and they could not fully express the feeling of mountains and waters stretching away into vast distance.

units.source_text: 而右方新作的画，虽然只是勉尽笔力，肆意粉饰，因而气品浅薄，

en.t: The newly made paintings on the right, on the other hand, merely strained the artists' skill and piled on decoration at will, so that their refinement was rather shallow,

units.source_text: 但是画面华丽热闹，令人一见不觉叹美，似乎并不逊于古画。

en.t: but their surfaces were gorgeous and lively, making viewers sigh in admiration at first sight, and they seemed in no way inferior to the old paintings.

units.source_text: 如此多方争论，今日的赛画便丰富多彩，趣味无穷。

en.t: With so many sides arguing in this way, today's painting contest became rich and varied, with endless interest.
